final: WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio FROM invoice_ratios) SELECT invoice_ratios.invoice_number, invoice_ratios.cost_ratio, invoice_ratios.line_item_count, invoice_ratios.cost_ratio / overall.average_cost_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC, relative_ratio IS NULL LIMIT 10
